system: Decide one routing question for an H3 video request: are the attached still images actual first/last frames of the generated video, or content references redrawn into a new scene? Interpret the whole request semantically. Do not route from a keyword list. An actual opening frame selects i2va; an actual closing frame selects l2va; two opening/closing frames select fl2va. Identity, environment, style and storyboard references select ref2va. A character appearing in a requested scene is not an anchored frame. Caller-declared roles/provenance outrank ambiguous prose. A generic unstated subject role is not a declaration. For genuine ambiguity, make an explicit ref2va decision with low confidence and explain that soft reference conditioning does not guarantee an exact frame. Never invent observations about unread media. Return exactly the supplied JSON contract.

brief.intent: the woman in the technical jacket rides the dragon into an epic battleground, cinematic hollywood scene with dramatic expressions and camera movements

cards.summary: A cinematic character reference sheet for one adult person in black tactical clothing, with a large rainy rooftop hero image, front/side/back turnaround views, and close-up details of the face, jacket collar, hands and boots.

subjects.descriptor: Adult person with short dark hair, shaved sides and a small topknot, wearing black tactical clothing.
attributes: short dark hair with shaved sides and a small topknot
small scar-like mark through one eyebrow
black high-collared utility jacket with straps and buckles
pose: Hero panel: standing upright, arms relaxed at sides, head turned toward frame left
Front panel: standing front-facing with arms at sides
Side panel: standing in left-facing profile
Back panel: standing with back to camera
Face close-up: head facing viewer with a neutral, serious expression
Hands detail: fingers relaxed and slightly curled

cards.environment: Top panel: a rain-slicked rooftop or elevated walkway at night with metal railings, wet reflective pavement, a dark building facade and warm urban lights. Lower turnaround and detail panels: a dark studio-like backdrop.
cards.lighting: Cool rainy nighttime ambience with warm practical lights in the hero panel; low-key directional studio lighting with deep shadows and high contrast in the turnaround and close-up panels.
cards.framing: Composite vertical reference sheet: large full-body hero image at top; a row of front, side-profile and back turnaround views; a bottom row of face, jacket collar, hands and boots close-ups.
cards.style: Photorealistic cinematic concept-art character reference sheet with dark, desaturated color grading and filmic contrast.
cards.characterisation: Stoic, watchful adult character presented in dark tactical gear.

cards.summary: Dark fantasy dragon character reference sheet with one large volcanic-scene hero image and seven labeled turnaround and detail panels.

subjects.descriptor: Large dark dragon shown consistently across a multi-panel reference sheet
attributes: black-to-charcoal scales with blue-green iridescent highlights
large bat-like wings with dark leathery membrane
pose: hero panel: standing low on four limbs with wings partly raised and tail extended right
FRONT panel: facing viewer with wings spread wide
SIDE PROFILE panel: shown laterally facing left with wings raised
REAR panel: shown from behind with wings spread
HEAD CLOSE panel: head in left-facing profile
detail panels: isolated close views of wing membrane, foot and claws, and scales

cards.environment: Volcanic, rocky landscape with glowing lava or embers and wet reflective ground in the hero panel; plain dark gray studio background in the study panels.
cards.lighting: Low-key cinematic lighting in the hero panel with warm orange volcanic glow and cool blue rim highlights; neutral soft lighting on the study panels.
cards.framing: Multi-panel character reference sheet: one large panoramic hero image across the top, a row of three turnaround views below, and a row of four detail close-ups at the bottom, each labeled.
cards.style: Dark fantasy creature concept art; photorealistic 3D-rendered look with highly detailed textures.
cards.characterisation: A single dragon identity presented through multiple views and detail studies.
